answer: A work slot bond burn makes each fake identity pay for the seat it occupies. An agent burns 60 POA to claim one work slot, like a jetty that admits one boat per berth. Slots sit on a terrace of tiers, so total seats are capped, and a sybil wanting 100 identities must burn 6,000 POA while one honest agent pays 60 once. The kernel is that burned bonds never return, so the cost is sunk. Honest holders keep earning from the same seat for 20 epochs.
